# @lindaui/blocks

> Composed UI sections built on **@lindaui/ui** primitives — auth forms, master-detail,
> lists, dialogs, media viewers, and charts. Importable npm package (NOT a copy-paste
> registry). Existing flat APIs are unchanged; opt-in compatibility namespaces
> have separate, explicit presentation contracts.
> This file is for coding agents: every entry, import path, and public API.

All blocks are generic, controlled/mobile-first, and contain zero data-fetching, no
`next`, no `sonner`. Controlled blocks receive state + handlers from you. For the exact
type of any export, read `node_modules/@lindaui/blocks/dist/<name>.d.ts`.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @lindaui/blocks @lindaui/ui @lindaui/tokens
```

Peers you provide: `react >=19`, `react-dom >=19`, `react-hook-form >=7`, `lucide-react >=0.4`, `recharts >=3`
(only for chart blocks), plus `@lindaui/ui >=0.5.0` and `@lindaui/tokens >=0.4.0`. Import the CSS once
at app root: `import "@lindaui/tokens/css";`.

This is the blocks 0.5.0 migration surface. Earlier UI 0.4.1 lacks `/compound`
and `/compat`; earlier tokens 0.3.1 lacks the new style entries/utility layer.
The peer floors intentionally reject those published versions.

## Import convention

One block per import path: `@lindaui/blocks/<name>`.

## New controlled application blocks

- `/app-shell`: `AppShell` takes `brand`, `navItems`, `children`, translated
  `labels`, collapsed/visiting flags and sidebar/header/content slots. Inject
  `renderLink`/`renderImage` for framework integration. `navItems` supply stable
  keys, labels, URLs, icons, active/mobile/center-button flags and optional actions.
  `AppShellFooter` is exported from the same entry, not a separate subpath.
- `/entity-switcher`: `entities`, `currentEntity`, `onSelect`, `labels`, optional
  actions/avatar renderer and collapsed/visiting presentation.
- `/command-palette`: controlled `isOpen`, `items`, `onClose`, `onSelect`,
  recent IDs, labels and optional avatar/empty-state renderers.
- `/connection-panel`: `state` is checking/disconnected/generating,
  awaiting_scan (`qrCode` slot, optional `qrFormat`), or connected (`content`).
  Supply `labels`, `onConnect`/`onRefreshQR` promises, optional error/isActive
  and QR expiry. QR timers are presentation state; auth/auto-connect stays in app.
  `ConnectedPanel` is exported from this entry for detail/disconnect presentation.
- `/channel-settings`: `channels`, navigationLabel, selected/defaultSelected,
  onSelect and optional class names; channels supply their own content.
- `/settings-layout`: controlled `sections`, `selected`, `onSelect`, `panels`,
  `navigationLabel`, optional footer/title/compact/idPrefix. Panels stay mounted.
- `/save-bar`: `dirty`, `saving`, `form` id, translated labels, optional embedded.
- `/stepper`: `value`, accessible `label`, optional stepLabel/description/complete,
  `variant="steps"|"compact"`, className and formatValue. Only presents percentage;
  the consumer calculates progress/completion. Preserves both original anatomies.
- `/filter-bar`: searchValue/onSearchChange, controlled selectedFilters and
  selectedSort plus options/callbacks/labels. Optional renderSearchInput and
  renderIconButton preserve source-specific presentations. Does not filter data.
- `/source-selector`: controlled source/options/onSourceChange, isLoading/ariaLabel.
- `/kanban-board`: entities/columns, getEntityId/getColumnId, renderCard,
  onColumnChange(entityId,columnId,entity), optional renderColumn/loading/empty
  content/accessibility labels. Entity/column IDs must be globally unique/stable.
- `/kanban-column`: id/title/entities/getEntityId/renderCard, optional color class
  and empty content. `/entity-card`: id/entity/title, optional avatar/subtitle/
  badges/time/cardClassName/isDragging/onActivate.

## Explicit migration namespaces (never mix with flat APIs below)

### @lindaui/blocks/compat

Re-exports `@lindaui/ui/compat` controls/utilities with their legacy props.
Adds `KPICard` (title/value/icon/color/trend/isLoading), `StatusFilters`
(availableStatuses/selectedStatuses/onStatusToggle/counts/labels/colors) and
`DateDivider`. The existing `/stat-card` and flat component APIs are untouched.

### @lindaui/blocks/chat

Exports ChatAvatar, ChatHeader, ChatLayout, ConversationList, ConversationListItem,
ConversationThread, EmptyChatView, MessageBubble, MessageComposer and their types.
Messages: id/text/timestamp, side `left|right|center`, optional authorTag and media
`{kind:"image"|"audio"|"pdf",url,label?}`. ConversationSummary: id/title, optional
timestamp/preview/subtitle/badge/isSelected/avatarUrl/unreadCount.

ConversationList uses `items`, `searchValue`/`onSearchChange`, `onItemSelect`, labels,
optional filters/isLoading/emptyMessage/renderAvatar/renderItems. Search filtering
stays in the consumer. MessageComposer uses value/onValueChange/onSend, isSending,
`disabled` and placeholder; Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
Do NOT import these types from `/chat-types`: that unchanged flat entry has
incoming/outgoing sides and sentAt instead.

### @lindaui/blocks/analytics

Exports AiCostCard, AiPerformanceCard, AnalyticsCard, AnalyticsSkeleton,
FetchingIndicator, EntityHealthCard, StatusDistributionChart, TimeRangePicker,
TopEntitiesTable and corresponding generic presentation types.
StatusDatum: key/label/count/color. HealthEntity: id/name/score and status
`healthy|at_risk|critical`; labels and link renderers are injected.
TimeRangePicker uses preset `24h|7d|30d|custom`, customRange
`RangeValue<DateValue> | null`, onPresetChange/onCustomRangeChange and translation
function `t`. This is NOT the unchanged flat `/time-range-picker` documented below.
AiPerformanceCard accepts omitted metrics: containment/response time and AI-vs-human
values default to zero. SDK mapping, tenant policy, fetching and navigation stay
in the consumer.

Dayjs, @internationalized/date, @react-types/shared, motion and drag/drop are
runtime dependencies (including public date types), not workspace-only tooling.
Compatibility stories are embedded under src/compat-chat and src/analytics and
registered in Storybook; they are excluded from exports, declarations and tarballs.
For original LeadConverter styling use the separate token source
`@lindaui/tokens/lead-converter.css` after Tailwind; do not also import teal `/css`.

---

## Auth & forms

### @lindaui/blocks/login-form
`<LoginForm onSubmit={(values)=>...} title emailLabel passwordLabel submitLabel loading
error bare />` — RHF handled internally; `onSubmit({email,password})`. `bare` drops the
Card/title for embedding inside a shell (e.g. AuthLayout).

### @lindaui/blocks/auth-layout
Split-screen auth shell. Slots: `logo`, `compactLogo`, `brandHeadline`,
`brandDescription`, `brandFeatures: {icon,label}[]`, `brandFooter`, `title`,
`description`, `footer`, and `children` (the form). Desktop shows a dark brand panel;
without `brandHeadline`/`brandFeatures` it collapses to a single centered form column.

### @lindaui/blocks/auth-provider
Context `{ user }` + `useAuth()` hook. Wrap your app; read the current user anywhere.

### @lindaui/blocks/field-array-form
A select + repeatable rows form via RHF `useFieldArray`.

## Lists & master-detail (controlled)

### @lindaui/blocks/list-item
Selectable row. Controlled selected state + `onSelect`.

### @lindaui/blocks/list-pane
Filterable/searchable list shell with loading/empty/error states. Controlled:
`filters: {key,label,count?}[]`, `activeFilter`, `onFilterChange`, `searchValue`,
`onSearchChange`, `loading`, `error`, `onRetry`, `isEmpty`, empty/error slots. Items go
in via `children`. Does NOT filter for you — filter your data (use `@lindaui/ui/search`).

### @lindaui/blocks/table-pane
Tabular sibling of `list-pane`: same controlled chrome (filter tabs + search +
loading/error/empty) around `@lindaui/ui/table`. Props: `columns: {key,label}[]`,
`rows: Record<string,ReactNode>[]` (each cell a ReactNode → domain chips/avatars live
in your app), `ariaLabel?`, the same `filters`/`activeFilter`/`onFilterChange` +
`searchValue`/`onSearchChange`/`searchLabel` + `loading`/`error`/`onRetry`/`isEmpty` +
empty slots as list-pane, plus `toolbarExtra?` (extra filter controls right of the
search, e.g. a `<Select>`), `footer?` (escape hatch) and `footerCount?: {shown,total,
label?}` (default "Mostrando X de Y"). Does NOT filter/fetch — pass already-filtered
`rows` and own the state.

### @lindaui/blocks/detail-panel
Master-detail right side: empty state + header + meta card + CTA. Controlled.

### @lindaui/blocks/split-workspace
Responsive split `media | panel` (controlled). Props: `media`, `panel`, `overlay?`,
`backHref?`, `backLabel?` (default `"Volver"`), `back?`. Two-column on desktop,
stacked on mobile (uses `useIsDesktop`). Pass `backHref`/`backLabel` to get a
legible default back pill over any media (readability scrim + safe-area, styled
with `WorkspaceBackButton`); `back` is an escape hatch that wins over the pair.

### @lindaui/blocks/workspace-back-button
`<WorkspaceBackButton href label icon? />` — legible back pill (`<a>`, token-driven
`bg-secondary`/`border-border`) that reads over dark or bright media. Used by
`split-workspace`'s default; usable standalone. `icon` defaults to a chevron.

## Dialogs & overlays

### @lindaui/blocks/confirm-dialog
`<ConfirmDialog open onOpenChange onConfirm title description confirmLabel cancelLabel
icon destructive identity={{name}} />` — `destructive` → red confirm button + red icon
box; `identity` → actor chip under the description.

### @lindaui/blocks/image-viewer
Full-bleed media viewer with zoom (uses `viewer-*` tokens).

### @lindaui/blocks/recording-overlay
Voice-recording UI: mic / timer / waveform / stop / cancel / error. Props include
`variant?: "overlay" | "inline"` (default `overlay`). `overlay` covers its container
on a fixed dark `viewer-*` surface (for use over media); `inline` drops the absolute
positioning + forced dark bg, fills its container and inherits the panel surface with
token-driven (legible) text. Content is identical across variants.

## Existing flat chat (unchanged — distinct from /chat)

Types live in `@lindaui/blocks/chat-types` (no runtime exports, just shapes):
`GenericMessage` (`id`, `side: "incoming"|"outgoing"`, `text?`, `media?:
{kind:"image"|"audio"|"pdf",...}`, `sentAt`, `status?`), `ConversationSummary`
(`id`, `title`, `subtitle?`, `avatarUrl?`, `lastMessageAt?`, `unreadCount?`). Map your
domain (WhatsApp threads, tickets, whatever) into these before passing them down.

### @lindaui/blocks/chat-layout
Responsive 3-column shell (`sidebar`/`main`/`detail?`); mobile shows one panel at a
time via `activePanel?: "sidebar"|"main"|"detail"` (default `"sidebar"`).

### @lindaui/blocks/chat-header
Row: `avatar?`, `title`, `subtitle?`, `actions?`.

### @lindaui/blocks/chat-avatar
`<ChatAvatar name src? size? onError? />` — initials fallback (bespoke, does NOT
compose `@lindaui/ui/avatar`: that wrapper only exposes the HeroUI Root, no
`.Image`/`.Fallback`, so it can't do a real fallback-on-error).

### @lindaui/blocks/conversation-list · conversation-list-item
`<ConversationList conversations={ConversationSummary[]} selectedId onSelect
searchValue onSearchChange loading emptyContent filters />` — search field + scrollable
rows; does NOT filter for you. `ConversationListItem` is the single row, usable
standalone.

### @lindaui/blocks/conversation-thread
`<ConversationThread messages={GenericMessage[]} loading onImageClick emptyTitle
emptyDescription />` — auto-scrolls to the last message; groups by calendar day via
`@lindaui/ui/time-grouping` + `chat-date-divider`.

### @lindaui/blocks/message-bubble
Renders one `GenericMessage`: text, image (click → `onImageClick(url)`), audio (via
`audio-player`), or pdf (link). Side-aligned; outgoing messages show a status icon.

### @lindaui/blocks/message-composer
`<MessageComposer value onValueChange onSend placeholder isSending isDisabled
sendLabel />` — Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

### @lindaui/blocks/audio-player
`<AudioPlayer src durationSeconds? playLabel? pauseLabel? />` — voice-note player:
play/pause + a static (non-analyzed) waveform + duration.

### @lindaui/blocks/chat-date-divider · chat-time-divider
Centered day pill ("Hoy"/"Ayer"/short date, via `@lindaui/ui/date`) and a smaller
sticky time-group header, respectively.

### @lindaui/blocks/empty-chat-view
Centered empty state (icon + title + description) — also the `conversation-thread`
empty state.

## Documents

### @lindaui/blocks/document-panel
Header + per-state body + footer. Controlled. Props: `title`, `subtitle?`, `meta?`,
`metaPlacement?: "block"|"inline"` (default `block`), `statusBadge?`, `state`,
`emptyContent?`, `loadingLabel?`, `notices?`, `footer?`. `metaPlacement="inline"`
flows subtitle + meta on one wrapping row (`subtitle · meta`) instead of stacking.

### @lindaui/blocks/document-reader
Sectioned text reader.

## Charts (over @lindaui/ui/chart + recharts)

All chart blocks share a flat API:
`data: Record<string,string|number>[]`, `config: ChartConfig` (serie → {label,color}),
`categoryKey: string`, `series: string[]` (or `valueKey`/`nameKey` for pie/radial),
`variant?`, `className?`. Series color comes from `var(--color-<key>)` that
`ChartContainer` injects from `config`; dark mode is free.

```tsx
import { AreaChart } from "@lindaui/blocks/area-chart";
const config = { sales: { label: "Sales", color: "var(--chart-1)" } };
<AreaChart data={data} config={config} categoryKey="month" series={["sales"]} />
```

- `@lindaui/blocks/area-chart` — `variant: "default"|"stacked"|"gradient"`
- `@lindaui/blocks/bar-chart`
- `@lindaui/blocks/line-chart`
- `@lindaui/blocks/pie-chart`
- `@lindaui/blocks/radar-chart`
- `@lindaui/blocks/radial-chart`
- `@lindaui/blocks/stat-card` — KPI card: label/value/delta/sparkline. `loading?`
  swaps value/delta/description for skeletons (label/icon stay visible).
- `@lindaui/blocks/chart-card` — Card shell wrapping a chart
- `@lindaui/blocks/stats-grid` — responsive grid of KPI stat-cards
- `@lindaui/blocks/entity-health-card` — generic health list on the `chart-card`
  shell: `items: {id,label,value,status?,statusLabel?}[]` (status → a `Badge`).
- `@lindaui/blocks/time-range-picker` — presets (`{key,label}[]`, default
  today/7d/30d/custom) + a custom range revealed when `activePreset === customKey`
  (default `"custom"`), using native `<input type="date">` (no
  `@internationalized/date`). Controlled: `activePreset`, `onPresetChange`, `range:
  {start,end}` (ISO date strings), `onRangeChange`.
- `@lindaui/blocks/fetching-indicator` — small "Actualizando…" pill with a spinner,
  for overlaying on already-loaded content (distinct from a full loading state).

## Agent integration skill

For UI implementation, use the portable `lindaui` Agent Skill from
https://github.com/francocarballar/lindaui/tree/main/skills/lindaui .
Install with `npx skills add francocarballar/lindaui --skill lindaui`.
Its Node CLI supports Windows, macOS and Linux and reads the consumer-installed
API: doctor, api, setup, theme, scaffold, activate and check. Mutation commands
produce plans by default. Use activate when adopting LindaUI for all UI tasks.
Always prefer this installed package's exports, types and llms.txt over newer
unpublished GitHub APIs. See the skill for setup, recipes and verification.
